name: MIRC Electronics Ltd (Onida Electronics)
tagline: Legacy Onida-brand consumer electronics maker with negative ROE, declining revenue, and elevated debt — fails the quality gate
business_overview: MIRC Electronics (renamed Onida Electronics Ltd in May 2026) markets consumer electronics across India under the well-known ONIDA brand — a legacy brand-turnaround story rather than a growth business at present.
fundamentals_narrative: Fails the quality gate on multiple counts: negative ROE both currently and over 3 years, near-zero ROCE (0.58%), declining revenue both over 5 years and in the most recent year (-11.61% YoY), and meaningful debt (D/E 80.9%). The ONIDA brand has legacy recognition, but the financials show a business in decline, not a growth/quality story.
technical_read: Down 27.41% over the past 52 weeks — a clear downtrend, not a breakout, despite surfacing in a 'breakout rally' search context.
